newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds tread water in directionless mkt.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds tread water in directionless mkt.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat late morning Tuesday as the market stood at a virtual standstill with an absence of client interest making it difficult to predict any new trend.
"The market has no direction, nobody is taking out positions," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 89-5/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 rose $0.05 to 125.60.
"Nothing is happening in the markets," said another trader.
Players said the recent directionless calm in the market was even more pronounced Tuesday as the U.S. Treasuries market was also seeing thin activity.
The result of the U.S. two-year notes auction later in the day could give some direction to Argentine bonds though, said traders.
